## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 42 captures during June 2021. The activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. All captures were considered in the subsequent review, with image quality reported separately from grading results.

## Image quality

Of the 42 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 11.9 per cent. These captures could not contribute to a grading outcome, and the image quality result should be considered alongside the overall activity level for June 2021.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day, indicating the central turnaround time recorded for the month. The report therefore shows 42 captures, 5 ungradable captures, and 7 referable results, with an ungradable rate of 11.9 per cent and a median lag of 1 day. Staff raised no new equipment faults during June 2021.
